plan: In a single-round auction with independent value draws, the optimal strategy is to bid close to, but slightly below my true value. Since my private value is $22, I want to maximize potential profit. I'll bid strategically at $21.9 - this allows me to win if others bid lower, and ensures I only pay less than my value if I win. This approach minimizes the risk of overpaying while still giving a good chance of winning.

My private value is $15. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid my true value. If I bid less, I risk losing an item worth more to me. If I bid more, I risk paying more than the item is worth to me. Since the values are drawn independently and this is a single round, I'll bid my true value of $15. This maximizes my expected profit by ensuring I win if the item is worth more than the second-highest bid.

My private value is $10. In a second-price sealed bid auction, my optimal strategy is to bid my true value or slightly above. Since the item's value is randomly drawn and this is a one-round game, I want to maximize my potential profit. I'll bid slightly above my value to increase my winning chances, but not so high that I risk negative earnings. I'll bid $10.50, which gives me a small buffer while still being close to my true value.
